profile.headline: Independent Full-Stack Developer at Self-Employed
profile.summary:
I build web and mobile products end to end, from the database schema to the App Store build.
For 6+ years I've shipped production apps in React, React Native/Expo, TypeScript, Node.js and GraphQL, and more recently native iOS in SwiftUI. Before that I spent a decade in banking data and BI, so I'm as comfortable in the SQL as in the UI.
Recently I've refactored a React/GraphQL sales dashboard used daily by sales and operations, built an Angular access-management portal for internal apps, shipped a World Cup 2026 sticker-trading app to TestFlight, and built MileLog, a SwiftUI mileage tracker with on-device OCR.
Open to full-stack and mobile roles in Denver, CO or Houston, TX or remote: parrajulio33@gmail.com

positions.title: Independent Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Shipped a FIFA World Cup 2026 sticker album app to TestFlight (React Native, Expo SDK 55, TanStack Query, Zustand, Supabase Realtime), with in-app trading, push notifications via Edge Functions, and a 981-sticker dataset across 48 teams.
Built a news cover image editor for El Comercio de Colorado (Astro, Supabase, Netlify) with canvas-based 1080×1080 export, a role-based admin panel, and a scheduled pg_cron cleanup job.
Built MileLog, a native iOS mileage tracker for delivery drivers (SwiftUI, VisionKit OCR, WidgetKit, Swift Charts), plus a cross-platform React Native version with odometer OCR and EAS builds for iOS and Android.
Built a business directory web app (Astro, Supabase) with AI business-card scanning using the Anthropic vision API.
Built and deployed sites for local clients, including a league management site for Latin Softball League Denver (auth, team and player CRUD, photo uploads) and an Astro site on a self-managed Nginx VPS.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · Astro Framework · React Native · Supabase · PostgreSQL · Testfligt · Software Design · Web Engineering · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: IT Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Skills: Web Applications · Angular · Git

positions.title: Information Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

1. Work with Senior IT Programmer / Analyst(s), users and management to assess software needs and system requirements.

1. Mentor Entry Level IT Programmer / Analyst(s) to assist them with their tasks and projects.

1. Formulate and communicate ideas for software to help solve business problems.

1. Design, develop, test, document, implement and support new custom-written software, as well as modify and support existing software.

1. Refactor and maintain EVO ReactJS Application and EVO ReactJS Sales Dashboard.

1. Create and refactor GraphQL schemas, types and resolvers as the company and the users need it.

1. Create HTML/PDF Templates on Netsuite Oracle and implementation of SuiteScript.

1. Create new app using AngularJS for User Management.

1. Create and documentation of RESTful API (NodeJS, Nodemon, Swagger) using Clean Architecture.

1. Create custom SQL statements (inner join, left join, right join) to improve expected results.

1. Create and maintain a cron job to update specific fields on Azure MySQL DB.

1. Set-up new users and maintain security rights.

1. Develop, run and distribute custom queries and reports, as needed.

1. Create and modify customer-specific product label templates.

1. Monitor existing software and increase performance, as needed.

1. Train users on new and existing software.

1. Provide 24/7 support by carrying a pager on a rotating schedule with other members of the IT Department.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Create reusable components using MaterialUI framework; Design, develop, test, document, implement, modify and support existing software ReactJS and React Native. Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing software; CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · JavaScript · React.js · React Native · CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

1. Translate UI/UX compositions into functional, extensible, and testable components.

1. Create and maintain reusable components in ReactJS and React Native.

1. Help and maintain the Web page on WordPress.

1. Create and refactor Python scripts used on AWS.

1. Develop readable code from an interface-first approach to deliver features on a timely cadence.

1. Provide feedback & review peers' code and refactor code when necessary.

1. Contribute to ongoing documentation.

1. Provide articulate mentorship of Mid-Level & Junior developers on clean code design and best practices.

1. Participate in all faculties of Scrum Methodology.

1. React development and Flux implementations. Hash-Routing, DOM, ShadowDOM, CSSOM, Box-Model.

1. Create and maintain a MERN app using NodeJS, ReactJS, MongoDB, Express Framework and Mongoose with MVC architecture.

       * React Native (Native CLI and EXPO)

positions.title: Monitoring and Control Data Base Operating Supervisor
positions.description:
* Identify, compare and resolve data quality problems.
* Evaluate large dataset for quality and accurancy.
* Correct data quality errors (Design and Application Development (Visual Basic 6, Visual Basic, NET, SQL, Server 2005).
* Determine root cause for data quality errors and make recommendations for long-term solutions.
* Maintain a record of original data and corrected data.
* Develop and Execute data cleanup measures.
* Ensure adherence to data quality standards.
* Analyze, query and manipulate data according to defined business rules and procedures.
* Customer Analysis databases (Important Bank) - Mass Remediation of Data.
* Participate in the broader external data communities to keep up with industry best practices and emerging trends.
* Evangelize the value of data throughout the organization.
* Create and maintain shared queries for others to review and use as needed.
